summary: The revision-.12 suggestion that failure of a uniformly nondegenerate physical 3x3 principal block leaves only a pure delocalized/CLT geometry is not an exhaustive structural implication. The exact target family A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m) has spectrum {1,1,-1}; every nonsingular physical principal 3x3 block has least singular value 1/m, yet the high-spectral projection has P_11=1 and one eigenvector is exactly e_1, so the spectral geometry is not uniformly diffuse or pure CLT. This does not refute QFORM; the family is bank-controlled. The same addendum independently proves the localized-principal-triple branch with ||p_Q||_infinity<182/c from completed scalar-pivot and pair-log theorems, avoiding the refuted arbitrary-joint coarea lemma.
